## Research: goldens home, common split, and sim / motion suite moves

Read-only check against NeoTech/Camcraft `main` at `d1484f02`.

### Answers to open questions

**1. Where do the `.cl` and `.nc` goldens live, and how do suites resolve them?**
- Today `crates/app/tests/golden/` holds `CLAUDE.md`, `53` `.cl` files, and `237` `.nc` files under `nc/`. Suites in three crates (`cl`, `post`, and `app`) read that directory.
- Those suites use four different path forms: `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/tests/golden`, CWD-relative `"tests/golden/..."`, `repo().join("crates/app/tests/golden/...")`, and `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/../app/tests/golden`.
- Per the Cargo Reference ("Environment variables Cargo sets for crates"), Cargo sets `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR` and test CWD to each package directory. Relative `"tests/golden/..."` fails when a suite moves out of `crates/app`.
- **Answer:** Move `crates/app/tests/golden/` to workspace-root `tests/golden/`, next to `assets/`. Keep crate-local goldens (`crates/post/tests/golden/`, `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/`, and `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/`) where only one crate reads them. Do not move goldens into `crates/cl/`: `xtask/src/plan.rs` lists `cl` in `SHARED`, so any `.nc` golden edit would force `gate quick` to run `batch`. Resolve `tests/golden/` in every suite from `Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../..").join("tests/golden")` so reads and `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` work from any crate.

**2. How does `xtask gate quick` know which suites read a changed golden?**
- `xtask/src/quick.rs` matches only paths under `^crates/([^/]+)/(.+)$`. Files under workspace-root `tests/golden/` trigger zero tests today (`"nothing in crates/ changed: no tests to run"`).
- Under `crates/app/tests/golden/`, a golden edit hits `rest.starts_with("tests/")`. That branch runs every `app` suite and misses `cl:headless_bin` plus all reading suites in `crates/post/tests/`.
- **Answer:** Add `xtask/src/goldens.rs` using the same design as `xtask/src/assets.rs` (#923), and call it from `xtask/src/quick.rs`. Scan every crate's test suite sources (via `xtask/src/suites.rs` and linked helper files like `engine_fixtures.rs`) for references to the changed file name, relative `nc/` path, or directory walks of `golden` or `nc`. Select each matching `crate:binary` suite, report unmapped goldens in `plan.notes`, and pin the behavior with `xtask` unit tests.

**3. How does `crates/app/tests/common` split without adding new crate edges?**
- `crates/app/tests/common/mod.rs` mixes pure `cl` helpers (`CL_SCALE`, `gen_to_cltext`, `write_golden`, `SYNTHETIC_MARKER`, `with_synthetic_marker`) with `flecs_ecs` and `camcraft_app::commands` (`create_past_the_tool_law`, `generate_past_the_tool_law`, `bore`, `rotary_bar`). Non-`app` crates cannot compile `mod.rs` because it pulls `camcraft_app` and `flecs_ecs`.
- `common::gen_to_cltext` duplicates `camcraft_cl::cl::text::to_text` (`crates/cl/src/cl/text.rs`), verified byte-identical in `golden_cl.rs:1031`. `crates/post/tests/recorded/mod.rs` duplicates `SYNTHETIC_MARKER` and `with_synthetic_marker`.
- `common/cl_read.rs` and `common/engine_fixtures.rs` use only `cl`, `geometry`, and `std` (`cl::text::from_text` parses `.cl` files). `common/solid_part.rs` uses only `geo2d`, `geometry`, and `sim::verify::ToolGeom`. `common/legacy_program.rs` uses only `post::cl` and `post::post::cnc` (`crates/post/tests/` already includes it via `#[path]`). `common/engine_consumers.rs` mixes `sim::stock_sim` helpers with `motion::machining3d::engagement_on`.
- **Answer:** Keep zero new `camcraft-*` crate dependencies (`AGENTS.md` crate-edge rule). Replace `common::gen_to_cltext` calls with `camcraft_cl::cl::text::to_text`. Place shared `std`/`cl`/`geometry` helpers (`golden_text`, `write_golden`, `SYNTHETIC_MARKER`, `with_synthetic_marker`, `engine_fixtures`), `solid_part`, and `legacy_program` into focused helper files included via `#[path]` (Cargo Reference "Modules"), or move single-consumer helpers (`compare_engagement` into `crates/motion/tests/`, `legacy_program` into `crates/post/tests/`). Remove the marker duplicate in `crates/post/tests/recorded/mod.rs`. Keep `bore`, `rotary_bar`, and `past_the_tool_law` in `crates/app/tests/common/`, and re-export the shared helpers there so untouched `app` suites still compile. Teach `xtask/src/quick.rs` to map edits in shared helper files to every including suite.

**4. Can `golden_cl` and the 5 generator-fed sim suites move directly to `crates/motion/tests/`?**
- Four suites import no `app`-defined item and fit `camcraft-motion` directly: `sim.rs` (`4` tests), `verify.rs` (`23` tests, `3` ignored), `posed_contact.rs` (`5` tests), and `stock_engine_agreement.rs` (`3` ignored tests).
- `golden_cl.rs` has `33` tests. Thirty-two tests use only `motion`, `cl`, `geometry`, `tools`, and `common`. One test (`plasma_plate_with_holes_matches_golden`, lines 1035-1036) calls `camcraft_app::post::cnc::parse`, and `camcraft-motion` does not depend on `camcraft-post`. Because `crates/app/tests/plasma_post.rs:229` already checks `cnc::parse` on `plasma_plate_with_holes.cl`, removing those two lines lets all `33` tests move without a new crate edge.
- `solid_law_goldens.rs` (`7` tests) has a blocker: four tests (`the_slot_trace_and_plasma_goldens_pass_their_gates`, `the_thread_golden_passes_its_gate`, `the_slot_gate_bites`, and `every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes`) call `posted_gates` and `thread_support`, which use `flecs_ecs::World`, `commands`, `operation::region_of`, `posting`, `machine::parse_mch`, and `app::stock_sim::simulate_document`.
- **Answer:** Move `sim`, `verify`, `posed_contact`, `stock_engine_agreement`, and `golden_cl` whole into `crates/motion/tests/` with `motion::` and `sim::` Gate maps. Split `solid_law_goldens`: move the pure domain tests (`every_depth_law_golden_verifies_exactly_as_before`, `a_lead_on_the_rings_own_circle_is_refused`, `the_synthetic_marker_is_accepted_only_for_a_fixture_with_no_op_program`, plus `plasma_findings` and `wire*` law checks) to `crates/motion/tests/solid_law_goldens.rs`, and keep the document/world gate checks in `crates/app/tests/posted_golden_gates.rs`. Update `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs` lines 56 and 65 where assertions look for `verify` and `golden_cl` under `app`.

**5. How do `stock_field_cost`, `warned_moves`, and `sim`'s release heavy lane land?**
- `crates/sim/tests/stock_field_cost.rs` already exists (`4` non-ignored unit tests). Moving `crates/app/tests/stock_field_cost.rs` (`1` ignored test) under the same file name causes a collision.
- `crates/app/src/warned_moves.rs` (`3` inline unit tests) imports only `cl::Move`, `geometry::Point3`, and `verify::Warning` (plus `MoveKind` and `FixturePart` in tests). `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:302` and `crates/ui/src/path_lines.rs:13` import it through `camcraft_app::warned_moves`, and `crates/ui/Cargo.toml` does not depend on `camcraft-sim`. (`app::fixture_struck::warned_moves` is a different helper and stays in `app`.)
- `xtask/src/plan.rs:165` sets `HEAVY_CRATES` to `&["kernel", "motion", "app"]`. Four `#[ignore]` heavy tests already exist in `crates/sim/tests/` (`field_block_cost.rs`, `fixture_mesh.rs`, `fixture_mesh_posed.rs`, `hidden_rest_banded.rs`) and have no release step today.
- **Answer:** Rename the moved cost suite to `crates/sim/tests/stock_field_golden_cost.rs` (`1` ignored test). Move `crates/app/src/warned_moves.rs` into `camcraft-sim`, keep `pub use camcraft_sim::warned_moves;` in `crates/app/src/lib.rs` (adding no edge in `crates/ui/Cargo.toml`), move `crates/app/tests/warned_moves.rs` (`2` tests) to `crates/sim/tests/warned_moves.rs`, and update `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs:56`. Add `"sim"` to `HEAVY_CRATES` in `xtask/src/plan.rs` (matching decision `#1783` for `kernel`), update the step-count assertion in `xtask/src/tests.rs`, and verify all `5` `sim` ignored tests pass in release (`xtask/src/lanes.rs` runs non-`alone` `sim` steps in waves of 4).

---

### Design proposal (smallest useful slice first)

1. **Slice 1 — One golden home and `xtask` quick mapping.** Move `crates/app/tests/golden/` to `tests/golden/`, unify path helpers on `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/../../tests/golden`, and add `xtask/src/goldens.rs` so `gate quick` selects every golden consumer across crates.
2. **Slice 2 — Split `tests/common` and remove `gen_to_cltext`.** Replace `common::gen_to_cltext` with `camcraft_cl::cl::text::to_text`, remove the duplicate marker code in `crates/post/tests/recorded/mod.rs`, split `std`/`cl`/`sim`/`post` test helpers out from `app`/`flecs_ecs` fixtures, and map edits to shared helpers in `xtask/src/quick.rs`.
3. **Slice 3 — Move `warned_moves` and golden field cost to `sim`.** Move `warned_moves.rs` (`3` unit tests) to `camcraft-sim` with a re-export in `app`, move `warned_moves` (`2` integration tests) to `crates/sim/tests/warned_moves.rs`, move `stock_field_cost` (`1` ignored test) to `crates/sim/tests/stock_field_golden_cost.rs`, and update `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs`.
4. **Slice 4 — Add `sim` to the release heavy lane.** Add `"sim"` to `HEAVY_CRATES` in `xtask/src/plan.rs`, update `xtask/src/tests.rs`, and run all `5` `sim` ignored tests in release mode.
5. **Slice 5 — Move `sim`, `verify`, `posed_contact`, `stock_engine_agreement`, and `golden_cl` to `motion`.** Move those five suites (`68` tests total) to `crates/motion/tests/` with `motion::` and `sim::` Gate maps, rely on `plasma_post.rs` for the `cnc::parse` check, and update `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs`.
6. **Slice 6 — Split `solid_law_goldens` between `motion` and `app`.** Move the pure domain law tests to `crates/motion/tests/solid_law_goldens.rs`, and keep the document/world `posted_gates` checks and `nc/` guard in `crates/app/tests/posted_golden_gates.rs`.

---

### Proposed sub-issues

1. **Move goldens to `tests/golden` and add golden mapping to `xtask` quick tier**
   Move `crates/app/tests/golden/` to `tests/golden/`, standardize golden lookup across crates, and select golden-reading suites in `xtask/src/quick.rs`.
   Done means: all `.cl` and `.nc` goldens live under `tests/golden/` with unchanged byte content, `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` writes there from any crate, and `xtask` unit tests verify quick selection for changed goldens.
   Proposed P: `P6` · Effort: `effort:medium` · Area: `area:build`

2. **Split `crates/app/tests/common` by crate layer and replace `gen_to_cltext` with `cl::text::to_text`**
   Separate `std`, `cl`, `sim`, and `post` test helpers from `app`/`flecs_ecs` fixtures, drop `gen_to_cltext` and duplicate marker helpers, and map shared helpers in `xtask/src/quick.rs`.
   Done means: non-`app` crates include shared helpers with zero `camcraft_app` imports and zero new `camcraft-*` crate edges, and all suites pass with unchanged test counts.
   Proposed P: `P6` · Effort: `effort:medium` · Area: `area:build`

3. **Move `warned_moves` and golden stock-field cost test into `camcraft-sim`**
   Move `crates/app/src/warned_moves.rs` (keeping `app::warned_moves` as a re-export), its integration suite, and `stock_field_cost` into `camcraft-sim` (`stock_field_golden_cost.rs`).
   Done means: `warned_moves` (`3` unit and `2` integration tests) and `stock_field_golden_cost` (`1` ignored test) run in `camcraft-sim`, `crates/ui` adds no crate edge, and `gate_maps_tests` passes.
   Proposed P: `P6` · Effort: `effort:medium` · Area: `area:sim`, `area:build`

4. **Add `camcraft-sim` to the `xtask` release heavy lane**
   Add `"sim"` to `HEAVY_CRATES` in `xtask/src/plan.rs` so `gate release` executes all `#[ignore]` tests in `camcraft-sim`.
   Done means: `cargo xtask gate release --dry-run` plans `sim heavy:` steps for `field_block_cost`, `fixture_mesh`, `fixture_mesh_posed`, `hidden_rest_banded`, and `stock_field_golden_cost`, `xtask` tests pass, and every `sim` heavy test passes in release.
   Proposed P: `P6` · Effort: `effort:low` · Area: `area:build`, `area:sim`

5. **Move `sim`, `verify`, `posed_contact`, `stock_engine_agreement`, and `golden_cl` to `crates/motion/tests`**
   Move those five generator-fed suites into `crates/motion/tests/` with `motion::` and `sim::` Gate maps, relying on `plasma_post.rs` for `cnc::parse` coverage.
   Done means: `sim` (`4`), `verify` (`23`), `posed_contact` (`5`), `stock_engine_agreement` (`3`), and `golden_cl` (`33`) run and pass in `crates/motion/tests/` with unchanged test counts and zero golden edits.
   Proposed P: `P6` · Effort: `effort:medium` · Area: `area:build`

6. **Split `solid_law_goldens` between pure domain checks in `motion` and document gates in `app`**
   Move the pure depth-law, crossing-law, plasma-law, and wire-law checks to `crates/motion/tests/solid_law_goldens.rs`, and keep `flecs_ecs`/document gate checks in `crates/app/tests/posted_golden_gates.rs`.
   Done means: pure golden law checks run in `camcraft-motion` with no `camcraft_app` dependency, document gate checks (`slot`, `trace`, `thread`, `sinker`, and `nc/` audit) pass in `camcraft-app`, and total coverage stays intact.
   Proposed P: `P6` · Effort: `effort:medium` · Area: `area:build`
